content: Reference latency tools: OboeTester (google/oboe, Apache-2.0) LatencyAnalyzer.h uses smoothed-Manchester-encoded random bits + normalized correlation, reports confidence 0-1; jack_delay (Fons Adriaensen) uses 13-sine phase method, ~1/1000 sample accuracy; jack_iodelay (GPL) loopback; jack_midi_latency (x42, GPL-2, 2013) MIDI loop; alsa-midi-latency-test (Linux); RTL Utility (Oblique Audio) free but closed. No maintained open-source macOS MIDI-to-audio latency tool found.
